title: Agent session creation service
discoveries: Drizzle mode:'json' columns are already parsed objects at runtime — no need for manual JSON.parse()
Cross-package constant sharing requires moving to a shared types package, not duplicating
Service layer functions (not just routers) belong in packages/api/src/services/ for clean imports
what_worked: Moving MODEL_MAP and DEFAULT_TOOLS to @nomos-ai/types eliminated 3 copies of the same data
Testing real functions with Bun mock.module provides better coverage than testing logic copies
Separating service (createAgentSession) from router endpoint keeps concerns clean
buildSystemPrompt as a pure function is easy to test and extend
configureTools with optional override parameter provides extensibility without complexity
what_failed: Initial implementation duplicated MODEL_MAP in 3 places — caught by QA review
Tests initially tested logic copies instead of real implementation — caught by QA review
Silent JSON parsing in try-catch hid potential data quality issues — unnecessary since Drizzle handles it
recommendations: For future agent features: import MODEL_MAP and DEFAULT_TOOLS from @nomos-ai/types, not agent-client.ts
Always check Drizzle column mode before adding manual JSON.parse() — mode:'json' does it automatically
When creating services in packages/api, put them in src/services/ directory
For cross-package constants: always put in @nomos-ai/types to avoid circular dependencies
F033 (Agent execution with streaming) should import createAgentSession from packages/api/src/services/agent-service
